meta.title: Apply to adopt
meta.description: Apply to adopt a cat from Happy Paws Cat Rescue. Tell us about yourself and the home you could offer.

s1.p: Tell us a little about yourself and the home you could offer. All adoptions are subject to a home check and an adoption donation.
s1.p2: Not sure yet? [See how adoption works](/adopting/) or [ask us a question](/contact/).

form.intro: Fill in the form, including the name of the cat you would like to adopt. You can ask us a question in it too.
steps: We reply and answer your questions.
We chat, and check your home.
Your new family member comes home.
